hero.bio:
Based in  Ahmedabad 🇮🇳 ,
I build scalable, production-grade Software with a focus on reliability and zero-runtime-error systems. Beyond code, I'm into chess, fitness, and logical thinking — always researching, reading TLDRs, collaborating with teams, and exploring DevOps and AI integration to build what's next.

aboutShort.title: About
aboutShort.p1: Making things work smoothly behind the scenes, learning something new everyday, and figuring out software architecture is what the routine looks like—driven by a genuine curiosity for how things tick.
aboutShort.p2: Spanning DevOps, Git workflows, and personal projects, the day-to-day toolkit leans on Python, JSON, automation, and hands-on building

workSection.title: Work
workSection.intro: I focus on reliable production software—from multi-portal architecture and automated deployments to processing and managing large-scale data workflows.

items.description: As a Jr. Python Developer at Size Metrics Design & Engineering, I'm focused on building and improving in-house softwares, developing backend solutions, and making everyday workflows more reliable.
At SNB Innovations, I moved into full-stack development, working on frontend interfaces and backend systems.
I started as a DevOps Intern at Sahana System Limited, getting hands-on with cloud infrastructure and deployment automation.
